title: Implement the BoardCore document and editor engine
summary: Implement the repository's first bounded delivery program: deliver versioned documents, pages, layers, typed objects, transforms, source references, command history, migrations, and recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Reconcile current source, status, tests, open work, and capstone evidence for the role `internal visual product, design, diagram, and proposal workspace`.
Deliver the bounded domain outcome: deliver versioned documents, pages, layers, typed objects, transforms, source references, command history, migrations, and recovery.
Respect the repository lifecycle disposition `build` and do not expand scope beyond it.
Publish a responsibility map for the current and target domain boundaries.
Define stable identifiers, versioned schemas, state transitions, invariants, and ownership.
Separate domain truth from UI, persistence adapters, external services, agents, and portfolio projections.
Document migration from current stored or generated state and preserve backward compatibility where required.
Add deterministic fixtures for current, legacy, malformed, partial, stale, and unknown inputs.
Ensure async work has explicit cancellation, generation, deduplication, retry, and idempotence semantics where relevant.
Ensure destructive or externally visible actions remain behind reviewed permissions and previews.
Define logging and diagnostics without leaking credentials or unnecessary private data.
Establish a measured baseline for the domain's critical operations.
Add focused unit and integration tests around invariants and state transitions.
Add failure and recovery tests for the highest-risk domain operations.
Keep localization, accessibility, and product copy ownership explicit where the domain surfaces messages.
Update repository architecture and data-flow documentation.
Update repo-owned status and evidence only after the new behavior is verified.
Do not add generic cross-app integration unless directly required by this product boundary.
Do not mix unrelated UI redesign or monetization work into this slice.
Run repository-native validation and record unavailable device, hardware, service, or credential gates.
Leave zero app-owned warnings.
